title: Charting the Landscape of African NLP: Mapping Progress and Shaping the Road Ahead
findings: The primary finding related to religion is the use of religious texts, specifically the Bible, as a key data source for creating multilingual corpora (e.g., JWSign, BibleTTS) for low-resource African languages. This is a pragmatic strategy to overcome data scarcity but is not used for analyzing religious concepts.
